title: Guarded Block Transfers for Polytope Distance: Linear Convergence with Explicit Constants and Gap-Certified Screening for SVM Training
abstract: arXiv:2610.15829v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Hard-margin SVM training is the distance problem between two convex hulls, which the Triangle Algorithm (TA) solves with a certified duality gap. We propose \emph{guarded block transfers}: $k$ Mitchell--Demyanov--Malozemov (MDM) transfers per scan are aggregated into one exact line search, guarded by a comparison with the single best transfer at a cost independent of the number of points $n$, and replaced by an away step when the leading transfer is capacity-clipped. On the Minkowski-difference polytope, where the objective is $1$-strongly convex, we prove global linear convergence with explicit constants and no combinatorial swap-step bounds; the per-step contraction is $k$-independent and only the drop-count bound grows with $k$, so aggregation is provably safe while the saving in scans is measured, not proved. Since the TA certificate is the Frank--Wolfe gap divided by the current distance, gap-safe screening applies, and we bound

translated_abstract: 硬间隔SVM训练等价于两个凸包之间的距离问题，三角形算法以认证的对偶间隙求解该问题。我们提出“受保护块转移”：将每次扫描中的k次Mitchell–Demyanov–Malozemov（MDM）转移聚合为一次精确线搜索，通过与单次最优转移的比较进行保护（该比较的代价与点数n无关），并在主导转移因容量被裁剪时以-away步替换。在Minkowski差多胞形上，目标函数为1-强凸，我们证明了具有显式常数的全局线性收敛，且无需组合式的swap-step界；每步收缩率与k无关，仅drop-count界随k增长，因此聚合被证明是安全的，而扫描次数的节省是通过测量而非证明得到的。由于TA证书是Frank–Wolfe间隙除以当前距离，因此间隙安全筛选得以适用，并且我们对……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出受保护块转移方法，将k次MDM转移聚合为一次受保护的精确线搜索，在Minkowski差多胞形上证明了具有显式常数的全局线性收敛，并利用TA证书实现了SVM训练的间隙安全筛选。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes guarded block transfers that aggregate k MDM transfers into one protected exact line search, proving global linear convergence with explicit constants on the Minkowski-difference polytope and enabling gap-safe screening for SVM training.
